title: SQLite 事务索引实验
body: SQLite WAL 事务保存 checkpoint。The search index stores compressed postings and verifies every decoded block.

title: 稀疏倒排与跳表
body: 倒排列表按 doc_id 升序，差值编码后使用 base128 变长字节写入分块，跳表按固定步长跳跃求交。

title: Quantization error bounds
body: BM25 weights live in the natural-log domain. Fixed-point storage records a scale and half-step error bound for every term.

title: 查询延迟与缓存指纹
body: Cache keys contain the query term set, semantics, config version and index fingerprint. Stale cache entries are never reused.

title: 并发发布保护
body: SQLite conditional updates plus an operating-system file lock reject stale checkpoints and require consecutive sequence numbers.
